SELECT AVG(e.salary) AS avg_salary 
FROM Employees e 
WHERE e.emp_id IN (
 SELECT emp_id 
 FROM Orders 
 WHERE amount > 300
);

with order_300 as (
select emp_id from Orders where amount >= 300.00
)
select avg(e.salary) as avg_salary 
from order_300 as o 
inner join Employees as e
on o.emp_id == e.emp_id;
